workflow_runs.display_title: Expose active review revision in the reader toolbar (#4)

head_commit.message:
Expose active review revision in the reader toolbar (#4)

Share the existing review revision model across the wide toolbar, narrow More menu and Review panel. Add synchronized filter/visibility diagnostic checks and an explicit UI scale override. All public policy, Linux PDF/UI and Windows hosted checks passed for the reconciled head. Manual native interaction, keyboard/focus acceptance and remaining T04/T06 gates stay open. No release version, tag or production-baking change.

workflow_runs.display_title: Make release-adapter tests portable in public source (#5)

head_commit.message:
Make release-adapter tests portable in public source (#5)

Separate mocked public adapter checks from explicit installed-controller integration, use the tracked compatible policy, and reject three-digit preview targets before writes. Add the public tests to CI and document authority-side integration as pending. Include the iterator-only baseline Clippy repair. Public policy, Linux and Windows CI passed on the reviewed head. No release versions, tags or publication changes.
